unit_day: วัน is also the prefix of every weekday name; the segmenter
takes the longest surface, so วันจันทร์ reads as Monday and
วันนี้ as today, never as this noun plus a leftover.
unit_week: Only สัปดาห์. Thai's other word for the week, อาทิตย์, is
equally the name of Sunday, and nothing in a bare occurrence
tells the two apart, so the week reading is not offered for it.

weekday_abbr_0: The prefixless form. Bound only where a marker or a date frames it:
จันทร์ is equally the moon and อาทิตย์ equally the week, so a bare one
names no day. CLDR's own relative-time data writes จันทร์ที่แล้ว for
"last Monday", which is why the short form must read at all.
